wikipedia.extract: The bald uakari (Cacajao calvus) or bald-headed uakari is a small New World monkey characterized by a very short tail, a bright, crimson face, bald head, and long coat. The bald uakari is restricted to várzea forests and other wooded habitats near water in the western Amazon of Brazil and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Bald uakari

commonNames.name: Aye-aye
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The aye-aye (, Daubentonia madagascariensis) is a long-fingered lemur, a strepsirrhine primate native to Madagascar with rodent-like teeth that perpetually grow and a special thin middle finger that they can use to catch grubs and larvae out of tree trunks. It is the world's largest nocturnal primate.
wikipedia.title: Aye-aye

wikipedia.extract: Procellaria is a genus of Southern Ocean long-winged seabirds related to prions, and the type genus of the order Procellariiformes. The black petrel (Procellaria parkinsoni) ranges in the Pacific Ocean, and as far north as Central America.
wikipedia.title: Procellaria

commonNames.name: Laotian Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Laotian langur or white-browed black langur (Trachypithecus laotum) is a species of the primate family Cercopithecidae that is endemic to Laos in Southeast Asia. It is closely related to other primates found in the region such as Indochinese black langur and Hatinh langur.
wikipedia.title: Laotian langur

wikipedia.extract: Pyrrhura (Ancient Greek for red/fire tail) is a genus of parrots in the Arini tribe. They occur in tropical and subtropical South America and southern Central America (Panama and Costa Rica).
wikipedia.title: Pyrrhura

commonNames.name: Chowchilla
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The chowchilla (Orthonyx spaldingii) is a passerine bird in the family Orthonychidae. It is endemic to Australia.
wikipedia.title: Chowchilla

commonNames.name: Hairy-eared Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The hairy-eared dwarf lemur (Allocebus trichotis), or hairy-eared mouse lemur, is one of the most scarcely known lemurs. A. trichotis is a nocturnal lemur that is endemic to Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Hairy-eared dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: The American kestrel (Falco sparverius) is the smallest and most common falcon in the Americas. Though it has been called the American "sparrow hawk", this now obsolete vernacular name is a misnomer; the American kestrel is a true falcon, while neither the Eurasian sparrowhawk nor the other species called sparrowhawks are in the family Falconidae, hence only very distantly related to the American kestrel.
wikipedia.title: American kestrel

wikipedia.extract: Nesoenas is a bird genus in the pigeon and dove family, Columbidae. It is often included with the typical turtle-doves in Streptopelia or the typical pigeons (Columba).
wikipedia.title: Nesoenas

commonNames.name: Kloss’s Gibbon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Kloss's gibbon (Hylobates klossii), also known as the Mentawai gibbon, the bilou or dwarf siamang, is an endangered primate in the gibbon family, Hylobatidae. It is identifiable in that it is all black, resembling the siamang with its black fur, but is considerably smaller and lacks the siamang's distinctive throat pouch.
wikipedia.title: Kloss's gibbon

commonNames.name: Collared Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The collared titi monkey (Cheracebus torquatus) is a species of titi, a type of New World monkey. It is endemic to northern Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Collared titi monkey

commonNames.name: Formosan Rock Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Formosan rock macaque (Macaca cyclopis), also known as the Formosan rock monkey or Taiwanese macaque, is a macaque endemic to the island of Taiwan, which has also been introduced to Japan. Besides humans, Formosan rock macaques are the only native primates living in Taiwan.
wikipedia.title: Formosan rock macaque

wikipedia.extract: The collared titi monkey (Cheracebus torquatus) is a species of titi, a type of New World monkey. It is endemic to northern Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Collared titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Mancalla is an extinct genus of prehistoric flightless alcids that lived on the Pacific coast of today's California and Mexico during the Late Miocene to Early Pliocene.
wikipedia.title: Mancalla

wikipedia.extract: Miss Waldron's red colobus (Piliocolobus waldronae) is a species of the red colobus native to West Africa. It had previously been described as a subspecies of the western red colobus, P. badius.
wikipedia.title: Miss Waldron's red colobus

commonNames.name: Bangka Slow Loris
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Bangka slow loris (Nycticebus bancanus) is a strepsirrhine primate and a species of slow loris that is native to southwestern Borneo and the island of Bangka. Originally considered a subspecies or synonym of the Bornean slow loris (N. menagensis), it was promoted to full species status in 2013 when a study of museum specimens and photographs identified distinct facial markings, which helped to differentiate it as a separate species.
wikipedia.title: Nycticebus bancanus
